question: Nishi travels to a shopping mall at 33 km/hr and returns at 57 km/hr. What is her average speed (in km/hr) for the entire journey?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When an object covers two equal distances at different speeds, x and y, the average speed can be found directly using the formula:

Average Speed = (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y)

Given speeds: x = 33 km/hr, y = 57 km/hr.

Average Speed = (2 × 33 × 57) ÷ (33 + 57) = 3762 ÷ 90 = 41.8 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 41.8 km/hr.**
